messages:
maria (sec-eng): Heads up — audit spike: ~1200 embeddings calls in 2m that bypassed per-route allowlist during a key rotation window. Logs show route="/v1/embeddings" but scope check returned OK.
sam (platform): whoa. link to the alert?
ops-bot: [ALERT] authz: allowed_request=1203 denied_request=18 route=/v1/embeddings window=2026-03-12T14:02:xxZ key_id=kms://rotating-key-17
jamie (eng-runtime): can you paste the sample header + token id?
maria (sec-eng): here's one header (redacted):
```
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***-tid:tok_89ab
X-Route: /v1/embeddings
X-Key-Id: rotating-key-17
```
and log snippet:
```
2026-03-12T14:02:12Z authz: token=tok_89ab check=PASS policy=per-route:allowlist(/v1/chat) evaluated=false
2026-03-12T14:02:12Z audit: user=svc-search action=embeddings model=text-search-1 cost=0.03
```
ken (eng-sre): wait policy evaluated=false? that suggests the per-route policy code path wasn't executed. could be fast-path fallback.
jamie (eng-runtime): We added a fast-canonicalization path for embedding requests last month to reduce latency. It skip-checks on malformed route header during load-shedding.
sam (platform): Was there a concurrent config push during rotation?
ken (eng-sre): kube events show a configmap rollout at 14:01:48 for routing-config v2.1.4 -> v2.1.5.
maria (sec-eng): timeline: 14:01:48 config rollout starts, 14:02:00 key rotation triggered (kms), 14:02:12 audit spike.
jamie (eng-runtime): hypothesis: during config rollout we returned a default route-handler that assumed embeddings endpoints are safe and used scope-fallback (legacy token acceptance). That fallback mistakenly trusts token perms tied to old key metadata, and KMS rotation left a small window where decrypt returned stale metadata.
sam (platform): can we reproduce in staging? steps?
maria (sec-eng): reproduce in staging: 1) deploy routing-config v2.1.5 with the fast-path enabled, 2) trigger KMS rotate for test-key, 3) concurrently send requests to /v1/embeddings with token that only has chat scope. I ran quick test and saw accept.
jamie (eng-runtime): thanks, I'll try to repro in playground cluster. quick mitigation: toggle the fast-canonicalization flag off (feature flag=embedding_fast_path=false) to force full policy evaluation.
ken (eng-sre): rolling that flag now to prod as hotfix. ETA ~2m.
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] featureflag-service: embedding_fast_path=false by ken (eng-sre) — started rollout to prod at 14:06:05Z
ken (eng-sre): hotfix applied. can folks validate audit counts?
maria (sec-eng): counts dropped to baseline within 30s. thanks.
sam (platform): root cause: race between routing-config rollout and KMS key rotation exposed a legacy fallback in the fast-path. Action items: 1) jamie - revert fast-path or harden to enforce policy check (P0) 2) sam - add gating so config rollouts wait for active key rotation quiescence (P1) 3) ken - add alert for authz-eval=false during production spikes (P1) 4) maria - produce incident blameless postmortem + audit diff (P1)
jamie (eng-runtime): working on patch to ensure policy evaluator is always invoked even in fast-path. PR incoming.
ken (eng-sre): adding an oncall runbook note: if KMS rotate + config rollout coincide, throttle routing updates for 60s.
maria (sec-eng): also recommend a short-term KMS change: set rotate to block-until-propagated flag for 90s for critical keys. We'll coordinate with infra.
sam (platform): thanks. low-risk followups: update test harness to simulate concurrent rotates.
ops-bot: [NOTE] incident created: INC-2026-0312-authz-race assigned to sec-eng
maria (sec-eng): good catch everyone. will start draft PM and share repro steps + log extracts in the incident doc. :thumbsup:
